text: Nightsaber Stalkers are saber cats found between the entrance of Darnassus and the Pools of Arlithrien on Teldrassil.

Nightshades are known to live in the Twisting Nether. In the Twisting Nether, three types of nightshades are known: nightcrawler nightshades, nightwalker nightshades, and nightwing nightshades. Nightcrawlers often travel in pairs, nightwalkers travel in gangs, and nightwings travel in flocks. In Manual of Monsters Appendix Three, the Nightshades are given a description, however, the validity of the source is disputed.
Nightmare Ectoplasms are oozes that emerge from the water at Dreamer's Rock in the Wailing Caverns during the awakening of Naralex, preceding the appearance of Mutanus the Devourer.
Nihil the Banished is a level ?? black dragon. He appears randomly in place of a quest enemy when the Temporal Phase Modulator from What Came First, the Drake or the Egg? is used.
Nightsky Armor is a random world drop from level 32 - 39 Eastern Kingdoms mobs.
Nightscale Girdle a reward from Doling Justice (2) which is part of the Freedom for All Creatures quest chain.

Nightmare Aberration are seen in the quest Hope Within the Emerald Nightmare where the player enters the Emerald Nightmare with the help of Remulos. They create a circle around the Shrine of Remulos to prevent further entrance into the dream. They are more of a gameplay mechanic, giving players a visual border of how far they can go before leaving the Emerald Dream.

Nightmare Figment are seen in the quest Hope Within the Emerald Nightmare where they player enters the Emerald Nightmare with the help of Remulos. They attack players that come near them and turn into a shadow version of the player.

Nightsong Garb set is the Tier 8 balance druid raid set. It is composed of any items from these sub-sets: * Valorous Nightsong Garb - from armor tokens gained in 10-man Ulduar raids * Conqueror's Nightsong Garb - from armor tokens gained in 25-man Ulduar raids

Nightmare Depths is a small area of land with some coral east of the Scalding Chasm overlooking the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths. Wil'hai, a whale shark, is being held Tentacle Horrors here against it's will. Bloodcrazed Threshers having smelled the fresh blood from Wil'hai are being kept at bay by Wavespeaker Valoren.

__NOTOC__ The Nightmare Scar is a location within the Overgrowth in the Southern Barrens that served as a rift to the Emerald Nightmare. Entering the physical world, the Nightmare's influence caused the plant life to grow uncontrollably and the wildlife to mutate. When Naralex discovered this, he and adventurers worked to seal the rift. The forest contains night elven ruins where Naralex felt a great tragedy occurred at. It is also a night elf archaeology digsite.
Nightmare Skitterlings are venom spiders appear during the nightmare gauntlet, in phase two, while you are attacking Helix Gearbreaker.
Nik Gi is a pandaren food vendor in the town of Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest. He is in a small building near the gazebo in the southeast part of town.

The Nightmarsh is a swamp located south of Embaari Village in . Many creatures including Echidnian hydras, Swamplighter fireflies and belly toads reside in the marsh. Twilight Glade is located on its southwestern limit.

__NOTOC__ Nightwatcher Idri is a night elf ghost located in the Drowned Gardens of Azsuna. She asks adventurers to kill Fathom-Commander Zarrin and escorts them to Prince Farondis, but like most of the ghosts, she hates the prince.

The Nightwatchers were main guards of Prince Farondis and the Court of Farondis. When Queen Azshara released her wrath for Farondis's betrayal, they too suffered the curse. For centuries, the Nightwatchers kept Nar'thalas safe and beautiful. Now, it's fallen to the naga, and even their own spirits turn against them. The Hatecoil naga disturbed the souls of the Nightwatchers in the Drowned Gardens. The mages of the Temple of a Thousand Lights conspired against the Nightwatchers.
The Nightfallen Hoard is a quest reward from The Nightfallen (quest).
The Nightfallen Cache is a quest reward from Supplies From the Nightfallen.

Nightborne Hunters are Unseen Path troops that can be recruted after Nighthuntress Syrenne joins. Rarely seen among the Nightborne, the Hunter class are experts at striking from hidden position. They often leverage the paths of the Arcway itself to attack, and then disappear before their foe even knew they were here.
Nightmare Drakes are nightmare drakes who appear in the Emerald Nightmare. They spit corruption at adventurers traveling between the Clutch of Corruption and the Core of the Nightmare.
__NOTOC__ Nighthuntress Lexera is a felborne located in Shadow Fracture on the Broken Shore. She tames fel-forrupted beasts, and Torturer Relyn serves under her.

It is also sold by Keeper Raynae for . Using the nightcrawler will enable the angler to catch Terrorfin. If this item is used after having obtained the Underlight Angler, one will instead be able to catch Terrorfin.

Nightfang is a shadowstalker battle pet located in southwestern Ardenweald, just northeast of Darkreach and south of the Garden of Night. It needs to be defeated for the world quest Lurking In The Shadows.
Nightmare Whelps are green whelps found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

The Nightmarish Hitching Post can be used by owners of a Warforged Nightmare every three minutes, which summons a hitching post only visible to party members. Interacting with it will apply the Nightmarish Reins buff, which temporarily transforms the user's mount into a Warforged Nightmare, with the cast time of a regular mount. The buff lasts for total of 20 online minutes.
Nixxrax Fillamug is a level 38 bread and drink vendor located in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay.
Nixxrak is a goblin heavy armor vendor located in Everlook in Winterspring.

's eggs during the week of Noblegarden.]] Noblegarden is an Easter event, taking place around the real-life holiday, based on the Western interpretation. Thus the event can occur anytime from the end of March to the end of April. Players can search for colored eggs hidden around 4 towns close to each race's starting area. Noblegarden starts on Easter Sunday, and lasts for one week. :The great feast of Noblegarden has long been celebrated by the races of the Alliance and recently adopted by those of the Horde. On this joyous day, it is customary for the nobles and lords from each race to hide coins, candy, and the occasional treasures within special eggs painted to look like wildflowers. Thes
__NOTOC__ Nissa Firestone is a dwarf first aid trainer located on the top floor of the shop Ironforge Physician, on the southern side of the Great Forge in Ironforge.
__NOTOC__ Nittlebur Sparkfizzle is a gnome mage trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. He also directs mages to Maginor Dumas for questing.

Nixx Sprocketspring is a goblin master goblin engineering trainer located in Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Nuxt Sparklespring is his employee. At some point when Chief Engineer Foote came to Gadgetzan, Nixx told him about the creator of Blingtron. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
__NOTOC__ Nissa Agamand is a banshee located at the Agamand Mills in the Tirisfal Glades.
Nipsy is a gnome vendor located on the Stormwind side of the Deeprun Tram.
__NOTOC__ Noble Topaz is most commonly found by mining Fel Iron, Adamantite, Rich Adamantite and Khorium deposits, or by prospecting Fel Iron Ore or Adamantite Ore. It is also a world drop.

Nimar the Slayer is a forest troll rare mob found at Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands. He is now a max-level rare elite mob, and a priority target for the Horde and the Alliance. He eventually succumbed to his opponents, taking many fighters with him in death.

Nimboya is a jungle troll located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. He has come from Orgrimmar to search for his chief's youngest son, Yenniku. Believing him to be in the possession of the Bloodscalp trolls, he wants the head of their witch doctor Nezzliok the Dire so he can force the whereabouts of his quarry from his dead lips. Ultimately, the adventurers are able to retrieve Yenniku's soul, although his body is still under Zanzil the Outcast's control.
Nimble Chrysoprase is an gem that fits a blue or yellow socket.
Nimble Leather Gloves are created with Leatherworking (120); taught by trainers.
__NOTOC__ Nitrin the Learned is a draenei quest giver located at the Abandoned Armory in Nagrand. His son is Levixus. He was once a member of the death priests.
Noboru's Cudgel was a poor quality mace which doubled as a quest starting item. it dropped from Noboru the Cudgel in Swamp of Sorrows.
No More Mushrooms! The trolls at Swamprat Post need something else to eat.
Nimboya's Pike was provided as an objective for Grim Message.

Nimblefinger Scaled Gloves are a quest reward from The New Plague and Anguish of Nifflevar.

Njorndar Village is a vrykul village located west of the Weeping Quarry in Icecrown. It is a smaller part of the large Vrykul encampment, Jotunheim. Quests here involve killing vrykuls and burning houses aswell as banners.
The Njorn Stair is a stairway just pass the Reaver's Hall in Utgarde Keep. Ghouls can be found here tunneling. These stairs lead up to Nidvar Stair.

Nitro Boosts is an engineer-only permanent "enchant" to the engineer's belt. It will give a 5 second speed increase every 3 minutes. The actual speed increase is 150%, which is 50% more than an epic ground mount. It can only be applied to a belt in the engineer's inventory, and applying it will cause the belt to become soulbound. The tinker stacks with Eternal Belt Buckle.
Njormeld's Pauldrons are a reward from the quest Forging an Alliance.

Njormeld is a frost giant quest giver located in Storm Peaks. He is the smith who is assigned to retrieve Fjorn's Anvil. He later assists in creating a protective monument for Dun Niffelem, and in reforging Thorim's battle armor.
Noblegarden Chocolates can be found inside a Brightly Colored Eggs during Noblegarden.
__NOTOC__ Noblegarden Merchants can be found at the starting areas of the Horde races. Their Alliance counterpart are Noblegarden Vendors.
The Noble Gardener is the meta-achievement for the Noblegarden world event. A requirement of the What A Long, Strange Trip It's Been greater meta-achievement for all of the world events.

__NOTOC__ Noblegarden Vendors can be found at the starting areas of the Alliance races. Their Horde counterpart is the Noblegarden Merchant. Vendors start and finish A Tisket, a Tasket, a Noblegarden Basket (Alliance), one of a handful of Noblegarden quests.
Nine Lives (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the Feral Defender while defeating Auriaya in 10-player mode.
Nikita is Jessica Morris's companion which is located at Vengeance Landing, Howling Fjord.
__NOTOC__ Ninsianna is night elf who sold relics and is located in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was seen kneeling and watching the stairs.

Nitro-Potassium Bananas is provided by Bamm Megabomb for Monkey Business.

Nils Beerot is a Forsaken "Psylosopher", who appears to holding therapy sessions with Drull and Tog'thar, apparently in trauma from their captivity at the now Forsaken-controlled Durnholde Keep. The sessions do not appear to be going too well. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Nimble Eye of Zul is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.

Nivi Weavewell is a goblin located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. She used to be a tailoring trainer in Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar, but was relocated to Azshara following the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy. She can still be seen around the embassy prior to unlocking allied races. Despite still being titled as a tailoring trainer, she no longer offers any services.
Nipnuk was the minion of the warlock trainer Kazrali the Witch, located in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar.

The noble's swordsmen is a roomsized apparatus commissioned from a group of tinkers by advisors to the Alliance Assembly; they wished to settle disputes with traditional swordfights, yet didn't want to risk any true physical harm. The noble's swordsmen requires two operators; each straps himself into a skeleton-like framework that wraps around him and telegraphs his movement using marionette-like cables to one of two life.sized mechanical soldiers. Armed with wooden swords, these soldier's movements mimic those of their operators. Their wooden bodies have compartments that can be packed with bladders ful of red dye in order to simulate injury in particular body parts. Though severing the con
No Static at All is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for completely avoid the Static Cling effect during the Asaad encounter in the Vortex Pinnacle on Heroic difficulty.

The nobles of Gilneas are the ruling class of the kingdom of Gilneas. Some were slain during the civil war, while others were turned into worgen or Forsaken during the Forsaken invasion. Others remain human in exile from their homeland.
